d: A prosecutor must work on a case which reminds her of her childhood, when her mother was killed by her alcoholic father.
A former colleague seeks Vicki's help to find out what kind of creature is now in possession of his body.
A were-cat seeking revenge against the hunter that murdered her brother plays a cat and mouse game with Mike.
Beth is wrongly accused of murdering her husband. With the help of an insurance investigator and her stepdaughter together they find the real killer.
